question_text: Construct count_delayed(staff_members, staff_id). Each staff object has identifier and projects. projects is a list containing project objects or None; each project has days and decision. Count projects belonging to the matching staff identifier with days>45 and decision=="N". Staff identifiers are unique. Return 0 if there is no match.
